Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing an inflationary adjustment for property tax levies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property tax levies; amending RCW 84.55.005; andrepealing RCW 84.55.0101.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.55.005 and 2002 c 1 s 2 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: As used in this chapter: (1) "Inflation" means ((the percentage change in the implicit pricedeflator for personal consumption expenditures for the United States aspublished for the most recent twelvemonth period by the bureau ofeconomic analysis of the federal department of commerce in September ofthe)) the change in the consumer price index for the most recenttwelvemonth period, for the Seattle, Washington area, for urban wageearners and clerical workers, all items, compiled by the bureau oflabor statistics, United States department of labor, for the calendaryear before the taxes are payable; (2) "Limit factor" means((: (a) For taxing districts with a population of less than tenthousand in the calendar year prior to the assessment year, one hundredone percent; p. 1 SB 5028 (b) For taxing districts for which a limit factor is authorizedunder RCW 84.55.0101, the lesser of the limit factor under that sectionor one hundred one percent; (c) For all other districts, the lesser of one hundred one percentor)) one hundred percent plus inflation; and (3) "Regular property taxes" has the meaning given it in RCW84.04.140.
RCW 84.55.0101 (Limit factorAuthorizationfor taxing district to use one hundred one percent or lessOrdinanceor resolution) and 2002 c 1 s 3 & 1997 c 3 s 204 are each repealed.
